name: Deep Regrets

categories.label: Mounted fish (after slot multiplier and Regret penalty)
categories.labelVi: Cá treo (sau nhân hệ số ô và phạt Regret)
categories.hint: Fish value (incl. madness modifier, min 0) x slot multiplier (2x/3x). If you hold the highest Regret value, discard your highest-scoring mounted fish first (lowest in 2 players); Cloche is lost too, otherwise doubled.

categories.label: Fish in hand (sum of values)
categories.hint: Sum of current fish values including the madness modifier (e.g. +2 foul / -2 fair at deep madness); a fish never counts below 0.

categories.label: Total Regret value (tiebreak, penalty check)
categories.hint: Sum of printed values on Regret cards. Highest value (ties all count) loses a mounted fish. Does not add points.

categories.label: Number of Regret cards (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Only for tiebreak: fewer cards wins.

tiebreakers.description: Fewer Regret cards wins; otherwise a tie

endCondition.description: Weeklong expedition of days; the game ends immediately when the last fish leaves the final shoal (caught or discarded), then end-game scoring.

notes: family: end-game-categories. Mounted-fish slot multipliers, exact madness-track value modifiers and the 1 VP per 2 $ conversion are reconstructed from BGG designer replies and posted scoring examples (Max scores thread: total = mounted + fish in hand + $/2), NOT read from the rulebook p.22. Highest Regret value discards the fish with highest calculated value (after madness and slot); every tied player discards, even if all have 0. Solo/co-op is a campaign catalog mode, not modelled. Expansions (Lamentable Tentacles, Even Deeper Regrets) not modelled. Needs review against the official rulebook.
